map_notes: The W-39/1 church-edge footprint must not be rendered as one all-glass block. The Pervititch crop shows a blue-hatched/labelled Camli-Vitre passage on the west/left part and a different opaque side/narthex mass at the east/right part near the Clocher square. The dashed and diagonal map lines are roof/glass-roof evidence, not a flat slab. Model the camli zone with glass material and an inclined/complex glass roof; model the side mass with opaque masonry and its own pitched sheet-metal roof.

zones.description: West/left blue-hatched Camli-Vitre church passage. This is the glazed part only, not the whole W-39/1 footprint.
East/right opaque side mass around the Clocher square. It reads as a different masonry material from the transparent passage.
